snippet.title: VEYRASOL — Official Cinematic Trailer | Real-Time MMO Strategy
snippet.description:
The Galactic Beacon fell silent. From the ashes rose three traditions — one of the Sword, one of the Shield, one of the Word. Only unity can rekindle the light.

VEYRASOL is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral. Build and specialise your colonies, command fleets in real time, expand across a persistent galaxy map and fight beside your alliance through seasons of roughly 120 days that end in a final siege for the Beacon.

▸ Open Beta: 19 October 2026
▸ Play instantly in your browser, continue on any device
▸ Steam Next Fest demo: 19-26 October
▸ iOS on launch day, Android shortly after

THREE TRADITIONS
Vanguard Line (Sword) — advances by assault, builds the new order from the ruins.
Aegis Protectorate (Shield) — endures through resistance, defends order, protects the future.
The Accord (Word) — unites through diplomacy, shapes the galaxy with the word.

Pre-register: https://veyrasol.io/en/
Steam wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4957910/Veyrasol/
X: https://x.com/veyrasol
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/veyrasol.io

—

Galaktik Fener sustu. Küllerden üç gelenek doğdu: biri Kılıç'ın, biri Kalkan'ın, biri Söz'ün. Işığı yeniden yakabilecek tek şey birlik.

VEYRASOL, Veyra Sarmalı'nda geçen gerçek zamanlı bir MMO strateji oyunu. Kolonilerini kur ve uzmanlaştır, filolarını gerçek zamanlı komuta et, kalıcı galaksi haritasında yayıl ve yaklaşık 120 günlük sezonlar boyunca ittifakınla Fener için savaş.

▸ Açık Beta: 19 Ekim 2026
▸ Tarayıcıda anında oyna, her cihazdan devam et
▸ Steam Next Fest demosu: 19-26 Ekim
▸ Lansman günü iOS, kısa süre sonra Android

Ön kayıt: https://veyrasol.io/tr/

#Veyrasol #MMORTS #StrategyGame #IndieGame #SciFi
